periods.time: End of the Seven Stars award ceremony
periods.label: 拍下并立瞬间的新闻社员
titles: 一辉与史黛菈的同班同学

status.current: interrupts the closing ceremony to take a symbolic photo

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Classmate and subject of her final podium photo.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Classmate whom she directs to stand beside Ikki.

periods.summary: Kagami waits until the festival is about to close, then floods the arena with identical clones to evade security. She reaches the podium, orders Stella to stand beside Ikki on the champion step, and photographs the two together, giving the festival a final image that reflects their side-by-side path rather than only winner and runner-up positions.

key_events.summary: Uses clones to interrupt the ceremony and captures Ikki and Stella standing together.

periods.time: Ikki's victory party after the Seven Stars Festival
periods.label: 庆功宴摄影记者

status.current: leads the toast for Ikki and displays Seven Stars photos
status.condition: sentenced to remedial lessons after making a scene at the award ceremony

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Senior whose victory she celebrates and interviews.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Subject of an indecent photo that Stella destroys while demanding the data.

periods.summary: Kagami opens the victory party toast, joking that she has been assigned three days of remedial lessons for causing a scene at the award ceremony. She later spreads out photos from the Seven Stars Festival and discusses them with the guests. When she tries to reveal a compromising photo of Stella, Stella destroys it with a heated punch and forces Kagami to surrender the file.

key_events.summary: Leads the toast and shares tournament photos at Ikki's party.
